title: Mani O NDE 195
content:
On the night of February 3, 2002 I had a very strange dream (this story is not a dream as you will see later on). I saw myself standing in an open, I guess the best words are, dead desert, there a was blackish grey sky and the ground was like hard dry cracked sand. In front of me were three hooded spirits with a well-like thing in front of them. It was long four to five feet in height with mercury type water in it. Though I never saw any faces or hands these spirits were asking me if I wanted to stay or go back. I honestly at this point can't explain it but I knew I wasn't dreaming it felt so real it was fearful. I said I wanted to go back. Then I was shown the well, with a terrible life ahead of me if I went back. I remember saying no, I want to go back, my kids need a father to grow up. The water froze and this incredible light appeared. It felt so bright it was overwhelming, though I couldn't see with my eyes; it felt as though I was seeing an image of Christ. He told me he would honor my request. I woke up feeling very strange yet alive and afraid even though I believed or wanted to believe it was just a dream. Later that morning I went to work, had my calls as usual, nothing strange, didn't even think of my dream. Later that afternoon, I got a string call, nothing to with what I'm doing that day, very easy call (you would wish every day you had calls this easy), but it was out of the area I was working in. Even though I didn't want the call, I still did it as the company claimed they had nobody else. What I didn't know at the time is that the call was refused by another tech as it was too dangerous. When I got there, it didn't seem like a big deal except for the fact that it was thirty feet in the air, but with a ladder it's not a big deal, I've done many calls like these. Oh well, I put my ladder up, made sure it was safe, then went up. I forgot something so I had to go back down. As I started to head down the ladder kicked out and I started to fall thirty feet with a hundred pound ladder. As I was falling there was silence, no wind. It wasn't cold. There was the light there with me and I looked down and saw myself after I heard the crack of the ladder. I saw myself on the ground. I was thirty feet in the air with this powerful light. Instead of snow, I saw the light ahead of me with beautiful warmth. The light, that was with me, let me got the light. As I was in there, I felt a pause, where now I was with the light of Christ, and watched myself as though I was traveling back in time where I saw myself in bed, the void, and the accident. It was weird because it felt like I was at all places at the same time. As I saw everything, I felt the light telling me that he would honor my request to go back. I said I will go back, even though I feel like I wish, to stay I must go back. As I descended back to my body something was said to me, all I remember is saying, 'I promise.' When I woke up there was a lady there and a whole bunch of people standing over me. 911 calls were placed stating that I had died. The first thing that I heard was the lady that was on top of me crying, then she became shocked that I woke up and said, 'You must have done good things for people and God let you live.' She then yelled to her husband who came over and said, 'You were dead, oh my God! You were dead, God let you live!' After that, police, ambulance, and firemen, all showed up and were shocked to see me alive with a bump on my head the size of a golf ball. I was rushed to hospital.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Felt as though seeing an image of Christ; later describes being with the light of Christ.
arrival.other_being_detail: Three hooded spirits (no faces or hands seen) asking if he wanted to stay or go back.

environment.environment_other_detail: Dead desert; blackish grey sky; hard dry cracked sand; well-like thing 4–5 feet high with mercury-type water; water froze; incredible overwhelming light; later describes beautiful warmth in/with the light.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Fall ~30 feet from a ladder while on a work call.

person_demographics.occupation: Technician (work calls; climbing ladder for a job).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Pre-incident 'dream' of desert with hooded spirits and a well showing a terrible life ahead; later during NDE he perceived being in bed, the void, and the accident as if traveling back in time and being in all places at once.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: A premonitory 'dream' precedes the accident; during the fall he experiences OBE with light; then a time/scene montage (bed/void/accident) before choosing to return.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: He reports it felt like he was 'at all places at the same time.'

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Premonitory 'dream' immediately preceding the accident featuring three hooded spirits and a well of mercury-like water that freezes, followed by an overwhelming light/image of Christ promising to honor his request to go back; later, during the NDE, a time-like montage of being in bed, the void, and the accident.

You were dead, God let you live!”
